text.en:
The Capital and seat of government of the Province of Cavite is hereby transferred to the
Municipality of Imus.

Lot No. 4711 of the Imus Estate, is hereby designated as the government center site for the
Province of Cavite.

The expenses which shall be incurred in said transfer shall be taken from the local government
share in the national internal revenue allotment and from the allocation by the national government to the
Province of Cavite.

Section 39 of Republic Act No. 981 which transferred the capital land seat of the Province of
Cavite to Trece Martires City is hereby repealed.
All other laws, decrees, rules or regulations inconsistent with this Decree are hereby modified, amended or
repealed accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
